judge.why: Candidate 0 cuts the meta-commentary and stays in character with a better looping setup.

title: The Laugh Thief Paradox
concept: Why we subconsciously steal our best friend's laughs and weird vocal habits.
insight: Social mirroring makes us naturally absorb the sounds and quirks of people we spend time with.

shots.scene: Leo and Mia sit at a cozy podcast desk, Leo holding a coffee mug with a smirking closed-mouth expression.

My lungs are unionized, Leo! I laugh how I want.

lines.text: Okay fine, keep the laugh as long as we get paid.
